config.modulation.title: Modulation Config
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla.fix_focu: Fixes a vanilla bug where buttons/sliders retain keyboard focus after being clicked.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla.attack_s: Allows you to directly attack villagers while they are sleeping.
config.modulation.tweak.figura.enable_ta: Modifies the /figura load command with target selection and autocomplete (@a, @s, ...)
config.modulation.tweak.music.enabled.to: Whether combat music should play when monsters are nearby.
config.modulation.tweak.music.min_pursui: The minimum number of pursuing mobs required to trigger combat music.
config.modulation.tweak.music.decay_time: Seconds required without any mobs around before the combat music fades out.
config.modulation.tweak.music.sounds.too: A list of Resource Locations for sounds to play during combat.
config.modulation.tweak.reconnectible_ch: Enables the Chain Staff logic and post placement.
The time (in ticks) required to hold right-click before the staff casts a post (20 ticks = 1 second).
tooltip.modulation.switch_zipline_mode: Shift + Right-Click to switch to Zipline mode
